scripts.prepare:app: bun install --cwd runtime --frozen-lockfile && bun run bundle:cli && bun run themes && vite build
scripts.check: bun run themes && bun run check-types.ts
scripts.bundle:cli: bun run --cwd .. generate:ascii && bun build ../src/cli.ts ../node_modules/@opentui/core/parser.worker.js --target bun --entry-naming '[name].[ext]' --external electron --external chromium-bidi --external camoufox-js --external sharp --outdir .cache/cli
